testcase.name: Scenario: Move the ribbon from the top to both sides and back: tmp/oblikovati-dependent-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:36:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Move the ribbon from the top to both sides and back ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is docked on the left ✔ And the ribbon is docked at the top with the 3D Model tab selected ✔ When the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and chooses Left from Docking Positions ✔ Then the ribbon tabs are arranged vertically along the left edge ✔ And the 3D Model command groups are stacked beside the tabs ✔ And the model browser appears to the right of the ribbon ✔ When the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions ✔ Then Left is checked ✔ When the user chooses Right from the ribbon Docking Positions menu ✔ Then the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged vertically on the right ✔ And the model browser is visible on the left of the viewport ✔ When the user right-clicks the active 3D Model tab and opens Docking Positions ✔ Then Right is checked ✔ When the user chooses Top from the ribbon Docking Positions menu ✔ Then the ribbon tabs and command groups are arranged horizontally above the viewport ✔ And the same part remains active ✔ And the model browser remains visible to the left of the viewport
